T01.1.1.desc: Implement object identity: object_id (unique, never reused), lineage_id (stable across versions), version (monotonic from 1).
ac: lineage_id constant across a supersession chain
Reuse of a retired object_id is rejected

T01.1.2.desc: Implement the universal required attribute set (17 attributes from IOM §1.1) as the base object contract.
ac: All 17 attributes present on every persisted object

T01.1.3.desc: Implement the universal optional attribute set (valid_until, duplicates, contradicts, supersedes, superseded_by, tags).

T01.1.4.desc: Implement immutable object persistence with atomic write per N-6.

T01.1.5.desc: Implement supersession chains: linear, non-branching, exactly one ACTIVE version per lineage_id (I5).
ac: Two ACTIVE versions of one lineage_id rejected

T01.1.6.desc: Implement configuration store per N-7: immutable, versioned config records referenced by engine_configuration_ref.
ac: Config history queryable for a given point in time

T01.1.7.desc: Implement failure record store per N-10, outside the object model.
ac: Failure records excluded from lineage graph
Empty result distinguishable from failed processing
Failures attributable to engine and invocation

T01.2.1.desc: Implement the seven-state lifecycle with per-type reachability constraints.

T01.2.2.desc: Implement status transition as the sole permitted non-versioning mutation.

T01.2.3.desc: Implement cascade invalidation per N-9: forward traversal, bulk transition to INVALIDATED, no interpretation.

T01.2.4.desc: Implement partial-retraction semantics at the object layer: an object retaining at least one valid upstream reference is re-versioned with reduced support rather than invalidated. Applies to the Fact attachment case once F03 lands.
ac: Object with some upstream references retracted remains ACTIVE at a new version
Object with all upstream references retracted becomes INVALIDATED
Rule is type-agnostic; Fact attachment behaviour follows from it

T01.2.5.desc: Implement ARCHIVED tiering per N-12: lineage skeleton permanent, content tiered by reachability.
ac: Objects reachable from any ACTIVE object are never archived
Lineage traversal never breaks after archival

T01.3.1.desc: Implement the closed ten-type relationship taxonomy (D-06) with asserting-engine attribution.
ac: Every relationship records asserting engine and timestamp

T01.3.2.desc: Implement objects-authoritative lineage per N-6: lineage carried on the object, version-specific binding (D-01a).
ac: Object is self-describing without the graph

T01.3.3.desc: Implement the Knowledge Graph as a derived, rebuildable traversal index.
ac: Graph is never the authority on a relationship

T01.3.4.desc: Implement backward traversal (object to Evidence) with guaranteed termination.
ac: Every non-Evidence object reaches at least one Evidence object

T01.3.5.desc: Implement forward traversal (Evidence to dependents) for impact analysis and cascade.
ac: All dependents of an Evidence object identifiable

T01.3.6.desc: Implement cycle prevention (V10): reject any write introducing a lineage cycle.
ac: Feedback Record cannot create a path back to Evidence (FR-I2)

T01.4.1.desc: Implement the acceptance path per N-8: Store enforces, rules specified in the object model.
ac: PROPOSED to ACTIVE gated by rule evaluation
Rules externally specified, not embedded in the Store
Failed acceptance produces a failure record

T01.4.2.desc: Implement universal validation rules V1-V4 (attributes present, derives_from non-empty, references resolve, Evidence reachable).
ac: V4 verified by actual traversal, not assertion

T01.4.3.desc: Implement universal validation rules V5-V8 (confidence ceiling, explanation non-empty, create authority, timestamp ordering).
ac: V5 rejects any object exceeding min(upstream effective_confidence)
V7 rejects writes from engines lacking create authority

T01.4.4.desc: Implement universal validation rules V9-V12 (status_reason, cycles, version increment, closed taxonomy).
ac: V11 enforces version and lineage_id integrity

T01.4.5.desc: Implement universal integrity constraints I1-I8 as continuous invariants, not acceptance-time checks.
ac: I5 (one ACTIVE per lineage_id) continuously held
I8 prevents REJECTED objects being consumed as input

T01.4.6.desc: Implement the semantic-check hook in the acceptance path for rules structure cannot enforce (F-V6).
ac: Documented as not covering paraphrase drift

T01.5.1.desc: Implement the two-component confidence model: evidential_support, assertion_confidence, effective_confidence with band labels.

T01.5.2.desc: Implement the monotonic ceiling rule: effective_confidence <= min(upstream effective_confidence).
ac: Worked chain 0.62 to 0.58 reproduces IOM example

T01.5.3.desc: Implement the evidential_support function per S-2, over independent source count and diversity.

T01.5.4.desc: Implement the independent-source-count summary attribute per M-23, carried on every object.
ac: Available to Pattern Intelligence at depth 3

T01.5.5.desc: Implement calibration rubric conformance: engines assert confidence against the S-1 rubric.

T01.6.1.desc: Implement scheduled batch invocation per N-11 and the M-35 control model.

T01.6.2.desc: Implement processing-state tracking: what has been processed, by which engine, when.
ac: State held outside the object model
Orchestration reads metadata only, never content

T01.6.3.desc: Implement failure surfacing: engine failures recorded and visible, never masked as completion.
ac: Failed invocation distinguishable from empty result
Failures do not silently halt the pipeline

T01.6.4.desc: Implement concurrency boundary per N-11: parallel acquisition/extraction, serialised interpretation.
ac: Pattern Intelligence sees a stable population per batch

T01.6.5.desc: Implement sequencing enforcement: an engine cannot run before its inputs exist.

T01.7.1.desc: Realise the Evidence object type: attributes, E-V1..E-V6, E-I1..E-I4.

T01.7.2.desc: Realise the Fact object type including the evidence_attachment structure and F-V1..F-V6.

T01.7.3.desc: Realise the Problem object type: attributes, P-V1..P-V6, P-I1..P-I4.

T01.7.4.desc: Realise the Pattern object type: attributes, PT-V1..PT-V6, PT-I1..PT-I4.
ac: PT-V2 rejects patterns over versions of one problem

T01.7.5.desc: Realise the Opportunity object type: attributes, O-V1..O-V7, O-I1..O-I4.
ac: Object cannot reach ACTIVE while scoring undefined (documented)

T01.7.6.desc: Realise the Solution object type including structured assumptions and S-V1..S-V6.
ac: Each assumption has criticality and testability

T01.7.7.desc: Realise the Validation object type: attributes, V-V1..V-V6, V-I1..V-I4.
ac: Negative result is ACTIVE, never REJECTED
tests_claim targets a specific claim, not a whole object

T01.7.8.desc: Realise the Execution Record object type: attributes, X-V1..X-V6. Create authority remains unassigned pending C-02.
ac: No engine holds create authority yet

T01.7.9.desc: Realise the Feedback Record object type: attributes, FR-V1..FR-V6, FR-I1..FR-I4.
ac: FR-V6 restricts derivation to Execution Records only

T01.8.1.desc: Verify the P1 exit criteria: objects persistable with enforced references, bidirectional lineage traversal, attribution on every write, structural validity enforced.
